title: Re-examination of the 1919 eclipse light-deflection measurements

hypotheses.statement: Starlight is not deflected by the Sun (alpha = 0).

geometry_assumptions: light ray grazing a spherical Sun of mass M_sun
deflection scales as 1/b with impact parameter b
radial displacement away from the Sun's centre

evaluation_criteria: likelihood and information criteria relative to the free-amplitude model, per instrument

hypotheses.statement: Starlight is deflected by the 'Newtonian' half value, alpha(b) = 2GM/(c^2 b).

geometry_assumptions: light ray grazing a spherical Sun of mass M_sun
deflection scales as 1/b with impact parameter b
radial displacement away from the Sun's centre

evaluation_criteria: likelihood and information criteria relative to the free-amplitude model, per instrument

hypotheses.statement: Starlight is deflected by the general-relativistic value, alpha(b) = 4GM/(c^2 b).

geometry_assumptions: light ray grazing a spherical Sun of mass M_sun
deflection scales as 1/b with impact parameter b
radial displacement away from the Sun's centre

evaluation_criteria: likelihood and information criteria relative to the free-amplitude model, per instrument

hypotheses.statement: The limb deflection is a free amplitude alpha estimated from the plates.

geometry_assumptions: light ray grazing a spherical Sun of mass M_sun
deflection scales as 1/b with impact parameter b
radial displacement away from the Sun's centre

evaluation_criteria: posterior interval on alpha per instrument and scenario

gates.description: Every transcribed measurement links to a source page or table
Every measurement used in a fit has a second-pass verification record
GRDeflection and HalfDeflection reproduce the analytic limb values within NumericalPolicy tolerance
Historical published estimates reproduced within tolerances recorded in this predeclaration
All four hypotheses evaluated on every instrument set separately
Sensitivity sweep complete; the report states which conclusions survive all scenarios
Comparison with the 2020 reanalysis present, with agreements and disagreements listed
Independent implementation of the fitter agrees on alpha within tolerance
The dossier never describes a table-based reanalysis as a plate remeasurement

targets.reason: Sobral 4-inch lens plates: the instrument the 1920 paper relied on most
Sobral astrographic plates: set aside in 1920 for focus problems; their treatment is a scenario axis
Principe astrographic plates: independent site, cloud-limited, few stars

notes: DRAFT for Phase 0 review. REL-G-04 tolerances are provisional until the 1920 tables are inspected and transcribed; they must be finalised before freeze().
